decision.observation: The copper ore at ~(851,519) px still reads '! Unreachable Dig' after the drag, and the region between the platform's right edge (x≈735) and the ore is unmarked solid rock. Tooltip confirms the pointer is on COPPER ORE 350.7 kg.
decision.hypothesis: A cell immediately adjacent to the platform's right edge at floor level should be reachable (2 right, 1-2 down from a standing dupe); designating there would start a tunnel that stair-steps toward the ore, unlike the isolated deep designations.
decision.memory: Dig orders on rock more than ~2 tiles from any standing cell never execute; the useful first step is always the cell touching the platform edge.
